title: WORLD TEXT DRAWS OVER THE DARK AND FOG
why: His order of 2026-10-09: the raid text reads like a shooter HUD, where a name or a number over the world is always readable. Teammate tags, nameplates, damage numbers and the floating labels (loot found, targets down, WEAK SPOT) were drawn under the darkness and the fog of war, so by night they were dimmed twice and a loot name at the edge of the light was a smudge. They are now drawn after both, in the same place and size. Only the draw order changes, and nameplates still show only on what you can see.
now: Loot names, damage numbers and nameplates now draw over the night darkness and the fog, so they stay readable.
